### Asa’s Religious Reforms
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/asas-religious-reforms
Passage: 2 Chronicles 15:8
Points:
- God promises His blessing when His people seek Him, but disciplines them when they turn away.
- Encouraged by prophetic truth, King Asa acted boldly to purge abominable idols and restore God's altar.
- Asa gathered people from across tribal lines to enter into a wholehearted covenant to seek the Lord.
- Demonstrating uncompromising obedience, Asa deposed his own grandmother for her idolatrous practices.
- Followers of God must never allow family affections to compromise their primary loyalty to the Lord.
